before.content:
---
id: GENBEYA-23
title: Edit tasks natively in VS Code
type: feature
status: backlog
priority: medium
labels: [vscode]
---

Beyond moving tasks between states: everything the app's task details offer, with VS Code's native means (quick picks, input boxes, the editor), no webview.

- [ ] Assignee, priority, type, labels, epic and custom fields from the context menu
- [ ] New task with a type, from the type's template, in an epic
- [ ] Epics as folders in the Tasks view, or a toggle to group by epic
- [ ] Filter the Tasks view (text, assignee, label, type)
- [ ] Comments: add, edit and delete the user's own, through the content manager
- [ ] Activity of a task
- [ ] Delete a task; move, rename and delete pages (with link updates)
- [ ] Sync the content branch, and show when it is ahead or behind

- [x] Status, type, priority, assignee, epic, labels and title from the context menu and the preview; custom fields in the preview
- [x] New task with a type, from the type's template; from a board column, in it
- [x] Board: swimlanes per epic, filters (text, assignee, label, priority, type, epic)
- [ ] Epics in the Tasks view, or a toggle to group by epic
- [x] Comments: add, edit and delete the user's own, through the content manager
- [x] Activity of a task
- [x] Delete a task; move, rename and delete pages (with link updates)
- [x] Sync the content branch
- [ ] Show when the content branch is ahead or behind
- [ ] Mention and reference completion in the comment box
